name: Weiguo Wang (王伟国)
description:
I am currently a Staff Researcher at ByteDance, where my research focuses on building Audio/Acoustic capabilities for next-generation voice AI, including on-device LLMs and voice agents.

My research interests lie at the intersection of acoustic sensing, signal processing, and machine learning. Over the years, my work has explored acoustic/audio technologies across diverse computing platforms — distributed microphones and smart speakers, home appliances, drones and vehicles, and mobile devices with on-device AI. I am passionate about building end-to-end systems that bridge hardware sensing, signal processing, and intelligent algorithms.

I obtained my Ph.D. degree from Tsinghua University, advised by [Prof. Yuan He](http://tns.thss.tsinghua.edu.cn/sun/members/YuanHe).
